mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 3-month moving average compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25pp over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points above the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 6-month moving averages indicates robust aggregate demand, boosting corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST exceed 6-month moving averages, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 3-month moving average signals supply chain disruption, increasing input costs and reducing corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 3-month moving average and CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) relative to the prior quarter indicates expanding economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 grows > 0.5% QoQ, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year increase in CPIAUCSL above 5.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to accelerate rate hikes, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 3.9% and increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.0% signals tightening monetary policy coinciding with labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 3.9% and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In low-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 3.0% annually), a rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 3-month moving average indicates improving supply chain efficiency, reducing input costs and boosting corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises above 3-month moving average and CPIAUCSL < 3.0% annually, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
